aboutUs.title: About Us
aboutUs.content:
Welcome to KenBarbershop – Prague's premier barbershop!

Ken Vintage – Cozy, classic environment specializing in hair cutting and beard grooming, providing a first-class experience.

Ken Modern – Modern and dynamic environment, which in addition to cutting and beard grooming also offers creative experiments with hairstyles through permanent wave and coloring services. To avoid confusion between branches, we recommend carefully checking the address before your visit.
